content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure. It’s a complete stack of tools that let you sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any third-party payment processor. It’s not a plugin or a script. It’s a self-hosted system. You deploy it. You own it. It runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. The moment payment confirms on-chain, the product delivers automatically. This architecture is designed for creators in countries where conventional platforms are unavailable. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation. It’s not a temporary fix. It’s a permanent alternative.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the flow: A customer lands on your storefront, hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select a product and pay via NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain in real time. A webhook fires, triggering backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This logic checks the payment status, logs the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and generates a secure, time-limited download link for the product stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The link is emailed to the customer using a configured SMTP service with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for deliverability. Every step is automated. Every component is replaceable. You’re not locked into any service. The stack is modular. You can swap out parts as needed. For example, if you want to switch from Google Sheets to Supabase for order storage, you can. The core logic remains the same. This is how sovereignty works at the infrastructure level.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this is for you. You sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or other digital products. You need a way to collect payment and deliver products automatically. You don’t want to depend on platforms that can shut you down or lock you out. You want to own your infrastructure. You want to control your data. You want to build on a foundation that no one can take away. This stack gives you that. It’s not a workaround. It’s a structural alternative. It’s built for creators who choose sovereignty over convenience.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative to Stripe-dependent platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and scalable. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. Order storage is managed by Supabase or Google Sheets, with Supabase offering more advanced features. File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and reliable. Payment processing is done via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. They work together seamlessly to create a fully automated commerce system. You don’t need to manage servers or worry about uptime. The stack is designed to be low-maintenance and high-performance.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing the stack that fits your needs. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed in 48 hours and includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and end-to-end testing. It’s configured with SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability and comes with 30-day support. If you prefer to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation, source code, and a scaling playbook. Once deployed, load your products, set your prices, and start selling. The stack handles everything from payment verification to product delivery. You focus on creating. The infrastructure handles the rest. This is how you take control of your digital commerce. This is how you build sovereignty.

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-hosted system that lets you sell digital products without relying on third-party platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Payhip. It uses free and low-cost tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to handle hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. The system is automated, modular, and fully owned by you. It’s designed for creators in countries where conventional platforms are unavailable, providing a permanent alternative to financial exclusion.
You own the stack. You control the flow. No one can shut it down.

It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and end-to-end testing. Deployed in 48 hours, it’s configured for email deliverability and comes with 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for a fully deployed solution or Sovereign Blueprint for DIY. 2. Gather your assets: product files, pricing details, and email configuration. 3. Deploy the stack: Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 4. Set up backend logic: Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure order storage: Use Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Set up file delivery: Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Integrate payment processing: Connect NOWPayments for crypto payments. 8. Test the flow: Ensure payment verification, order logging, and product delivery work seamlessly. 9. Launch your store: Share your storefront link with your audience. 10. Monitor and scale: Track sales, optimize performance, and expand your product offerings.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint includes full documentation and source code if you prefer to build it yourself.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the cryptocurrency back to the customer’s wallet. The stack logs all transactions, so you can easily track and manage refunds.
Can I use this stack for physical products?
No. This stack is designed for digital products only. It automates file delivery via secure, time-limited links.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub goes down?
The stack is modular. If one component fails, you can replace it with an alternative. For example, if GitHub Pages goes down, switch to Cloudflare Pages for hosting.
